routes.title: Free Construction Calculators for Home Projects | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free construction calculators for concrete, gravel, lumber, and flooring. Estimate material quantities, bag counts, cubic yards, and project costs.
routes.h1: Free construction calculators for home projects

routes.title: About | FixUpMath
routes.description: What FixUpMath is, how the calculators are built, and how to reach us.

routes.title: Asphalt Calculator: Tons of Asphalt for a Driveway or Patch | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free asphalt calculator. Enter the area and compacted thickness to get tons of hot mix asphalt, cubic yards, cold patch bags, and the gravel base for a new driveway.

routes.title: Board Foot Calculator: Lumber Board Feet & Cost | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free board foot calculator. Enter thickness, width, length, and quantity to get board feet, cubic feet, and cost. Add different boards to one lumber order.

routes.title: Brick Calculator: How Many Bricks & Mortar Bags You Need | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free brick calculator. Enter the wall size and brick type to get the number of bricks per square foot, total bricks with waste, and bags of mortar mix.

routes.title: BTU Calculator: Air Conditioner Size for a Room | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free BTU calculator. Enter room size, sun exposure, occupants, and whether it's a kitchen to get the air conditioner BTUs and tons you need, using the ENERGY STAR sizing method.

routes.title: Carpet Calculator: Measure Square Feet & Yards | FixUpMath
routes.description: Measure carpet in square feet and yards, add rooms, and estimate roll length, padding, and cost. Choose 12, 13.5, or 15 ft rolls and your waste allowance.

routes.title: Cinder Block Calculator: Blocks, Mortar & Core Fill for a Wall | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free cinder block calculator. Enter the wall length and height to get the number of concrete blocks, courses, bags of mortar, and concrete to fill the cores.

routes.title: Concrete Bag Calculator: 40, 50, 60 & 80 lb Bags | FixUpMath
routes.description: Concrete bag calculator: enter a volume, slab, or post holes and get how many 40, 50, 60, or 80-lb bags of concrete to buy, plus pallets, weight, and bags per yard.

routes.title: Concrete Calculator: Footings, Columns & Stairs | FixUpMath
routes.description: Calculate concrete for footings, walls, columns, and stairs. Get cubic yards, bags, and costs for one pour or a project, with waste and rounding explained.

routes.title: Concrete & Masonry Calculators | FixUpMath
routes.description: Concrete, asphalt, rebar, brick, block, retaining wall, and paver quantities for home projects.

routes.title: Concrete Slab Calculator: Cubic Yards & Bags | FixUpMath
routes.description: Concrete slab calculator: enter length, width, and thickness, add a thickened edge if you need one, and get cubic yards, 60 or 80-lb bags, and the ready-mix to order.

routes.title: Conduit Fill Calculator: EMT & PVC | FixUpMath
routes.description: Calculate EMT or PVC conduit fill for THHN wires. Compare fill percentages with NEC Chapter 9 limits and see maximum wire counts by conduit size.

routes.title: Contact | FixUpMath
routes.description: How to contact FixUpMath about corrections, feedback, or calculator requests.

routes.title: Countertop Calculator: Surface Area and Cost | FixUpMath
routes.description: Calculate countertop square footage for rectangular, L-shaped, or U-shaped tops. Count shared corners once, deduct optional cutouts, and add your quoted rate.

routes.title: Cubic Yard Calculator: Yards & Tons of Dirt, Gravel, Mulch | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free cubic yard calculator. Enter length, width, and depth in feet or inches to get cubic yards, cubic feet, and tons of dirt, gravel, sand, mulch, or concrete.

routes.title: Deck Calculator: Boards, Joists & Screws for Your Deck | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free deck calculator. Enter your deck size, board width, gap, and joist spacing to get the number of deck boards, joists, rim joists, and deck screws.

routes.title: Decks, Fences & Framing Calculators | FixUpMath
routes.description: Decking, fences, stairs, rafters, lumber, plywood sheets, and supported-span references.

routes.title: Dirt Calculator: Fill Dirt in Cubic Yards, Tons & Truckloads | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free dirt calculator. Enter the area and depth to fill and get the cubic yards of fill dirt to order, with extra for compaction, plus tons and dump truck loads.

routes.title: Drywall Calculator: Sheets for Walls & Ceilings | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free drywall calculator. Enter the room size, doors, and windows to get the number of 4×8, 4×10, or 4×12 drywall sheets and screws for the walls and ceiling.

routes.title: Electrical & HVAC Calculators | FixUpMath
routes.description: Wire size, voltage drop, conduit fill, BTU sizing, and insulation.

routes.title: Epoxy Calculator: Volume, Resin and Hardener | FixUpMath
routes.description: Estimate epoxy volume from area and layer thickness. Add waste, split resin and hardener by the product's volume ratio, and calculate combined kits to buy.

routes.title: Fence Calculator: Posts, Rails, Pickets & Concrete | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free fence calculator. Enter your fence length, height, post spacing, and gates to get the number of posts, rails, pickets, and bags of concrete for the post holes.

routes.title: Fertilizer Calculator: Amount to Apply and Bags | FixUpMath
routes.description: Calculate how much fertilizer to apply from area, a nitrogen target or product rate, and the N-P-K label. See product weight, nutrients, and bags to buy.

routes.title: Flooring Calculator: Square Feet & Boxes with Waste | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free flooring calculator for laminate, vinyl plank, and hardwood. Enter your room size and box coverage to get square feet to buy and the number of boxes, with waste.

routes.title: Flooring & Walls Calculators | FixUpMath
routes.description: Square footage, flooring, carpet, tile, grout, countertops, epoxy, drywall, and wallpaper.

routes.title: Grass Seed Calculator: Pounds of Seed by Grass Type | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free grass seed calculator. Enter your lawn size and grass type to get pounds of seed and bags for a new lawn or overseeding, using typical seeding rates.

routes.title: Gravel Calculator: Cubic Yards, Tons & Bags for Any Area | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free gravel calculator. Enter the area and depth to get cubic yards, tons, and bags of pea gravel, crushed stone, crusher run, or river rock.

routes.title: Grout Calculator: Estimate Tile Grout and Bags | FixUpMath
routes.description: Calculate tile grout quantity and whole bags using published MAPEI or LATICRETE coverage, or custom tile dimensions and a product-specific yield.

routes.title: Insulation Calculator: R-Value, Depth & Board Feet | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free insulation calculator. Enter the area, target R-value, and existing insulation to get the depth to add, volume, and board feet for batts, blown-in, spray foam, or foam board.

routes.title: Joist Span Calculator: Check a Deck Joist Span | FixUpMath
routes.description: Use the joist span calculator to look up deck joist spans by wood species, size, and spacing, then compare your clear span with AWC Table 2.

routes.title: Landscape Rock Calculator: Yards & Tons of Decorative Rock | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free landscape rock calculator. Enter your bed size and depth to get cubic yards, tons, and bags of river rock, lava rock, pea gravel, marble chips, or decomposed granite.

routes.title: Landscaping & Yard Calculators | FixUpMath
routes.description: Gravel, mulch, topsoil, fill dirt, sand, sod, grass seed, and fertilizer for beds, paths, and lawns.

routes.title: Mulch Calculator: How Many Yards or Bags of Mulch You Need | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free mulch calculator. Enter your bed size and depth to get cubic yards of bulk mulch or the number of 2 and 3 cubic foot bags.

routes.title: Paver Calculator: Pavers, Gravel Base & Sand for a Patio | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free paver calculator. Enter your patio or walkway size and paver dimensions to get the number of pavers plus tons of gravel base and bedding sand.

routes.title: Plywood Calculator: Sheets Needed for Your Area | FixUpMath
routes.description: Use the plywood calculator to estimate whole sheets from your project area, sheet dimensions, and waste allowance. Add a sheet price for material cost.

routes.title: Pool Calculator: Chlorine, Shock, Alkalinity & Stabilizer Doses | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free pool chemical calculator. Enter your gallons and test results to get how much liquid chlorine, shock, baking soda, stabilizer, or calcium chloride to add.

routes.title: Pool Volume Calculator: How Many Gallons Is Your Pool? | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free swimming pool volume calculator. Find how many gallons are in your pool, rectangular, round, or oval, plus liters, fill time, and water weight.

routes.title: Pool Calculators | FixUpMath
routes.description: Pool volume, chemical doses, and salt for saltwater pools.

routes.title: Privacy Policy | FixUpMath
routes.description: How FixUpMath handles data, cookies, and advertising.

routes.title: Rafter Calculator: Rafter Length from Span & Pitch | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free rafter length calculator. Enter the building span, roof pitch, overhang, and ridge board to get the rafter length, rise, plumb cut angle, and number of rafters.

routes.title: Rafter Span Chart: Southern Pine No. 2 Reference | FixUpMath
routes.description: Read the rafter span chart for Southern Pine No. 2 at 12, 16, or 24 inches on center. Compare published spans for two roof snow-load cases.

routes.title: Rebar Calculator: Bars, Linear Feet & Weight for a Slab | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free rebar calculator for concrete slabs. Enter slab size, grid spacing, and bar size to get the number of bars, linear feet, lap splices, and weight of #3, #4, #5, or #6 rebar.

routes.title: Retaining Wall Calculator: Blocks, Caps and Rock | FixUpMath
routes.description: Estimate retaining wall blocks, caps, base aggregate, drainage rock, and material cost for a straight segmental block wall using your plan dimensions.

routes.title: Roof Pitch Calculator: Pitch, Angle & Roof Pitch Chart | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free roof pitch calculator. Enter the rise and run, the span and ridge height, or the angle to get the roof pitch in x/12, degrees, percent grade, and the pitch factor.

routes.title: Roofing Calculator: Roof Squares & Full Material List | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free roofing calculator. Enter the roof footprint, pitch, and shape to get the roof area in squares and a full list: shingles, underlayment, drip edge, starter, ridge cap, and nails.

routes.title: Roofing & Siding Calculators | FixUpMath
routes.description: Roof pitch, roofing squares and materials, shingles, and siding for exterior projects.

routes.title: Salt Pool Calculator: How Much Salt for a Saltwater Pool | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free salt pool calculator. Enter your pool size or gallons and your current and target salt levels to get the pounds and 40-lb bags of salt to add.

routes.title: Sand Calculator: Cubic Yards, Tons & Bags for Pavers and More | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free sand calculator. Enter the area and depth to get cubic yards, tons, and 50-lb bags of sand for paver bedding, pool bases, sandboxes, and leveling.

routes.title: Shingle Calculator: Roofing Squares & Bundles by Pitch | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free roofing shingle calculator. Enter the roof footprint and pitch to get the sloped roof area, squares, and bundles of shingles, with waste for hips and valleys.

routes.title: Siding Calculator: Squares of Siding for Your House | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free siding calculator. Enter wall lengths, height, gables, doors, and windows to get the square footage and number of squares of vinyl or other siding to order.

routes.title: Sod Calculator: Square Feet, Pallets & Pieces of Sod | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free sod calculator. Measure your lawn by shape to get the square footage, pallets, and slabs or rolls of sod to order, with extra for cuts.

routes.title: Square Footage Calculator: Feet & Inches, Any Shape | FixUpMath
routes.description: Calculate square feet from feet and inches for rectangles, circles, and triangles. Add rooms to a project and convert to square yards, meters, or acres.

routes.title: Stair Calculator: Stringers, Landings & Diagram | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free stair and stringer calculator. Enter the total rise to get risers, treads, total run, stringer length and count, with an optional landing and a diagram drawn to scale.

routes.title: Terms of Use | FixUpMath
routes.description: Terms for using the FixUpMath calculators.

routes.title: Tile Calculator: How Many Tiles & Boxes You Need | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free tile calculator for floors, walls, and backsplashes. Enter the area, tile size, and grout joint to get the number of tiles and boxes, with waste.

routes.title: Topsoil Calculator: Cubic Yards, Tons & Bags for Lawns and Beds | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free topsoil calculator. Enter the area and depth to get cubic yards, tons, and bags of topsoil or compost for a new lawn, garden bed, or raised bed.

routes.title: Voltage Drop Calculator: Copper & Aluminum | FixUpMath
routes.description: Calculate wire voltage drop in volts and percent for copper or aluminum, using wire size, amps, and one-way distance. Supports AC single/three phase and DC.

routes.title: Wallpaper Calculator: Rolls & Pattern Repeat | FixUpMath
routes.description: Estimate wallpaper rolls from room size, roll dimensions, and pattern repeat. See full-height strips, cuts per roll, and the trimming allowance.

routes.title: Wire Size Calculator: AWG by Amps, Distance & Voltage Drop | FixUpMath
routes.description: Free wire size calculator. Enter amps, distance, and voltage to find the minimum copper or aluminum AWG wire that meets NEC ampacity and a 3% voltage drop.
